assumption: Guarded compiled compiler/support libraries correspond to LLVM pin.
basis: Actual compiler version/hash and native build input receipts.
falsification_probe: Any changed guarded hash or pin. No full clean LLVM/OS rebuild.

assumption: Observation labels retain exact original actual Core objects; no object manufactured from JSON.
basis: Session captures actual Raw/Pointer/Memory, immutable ref bytes/membership and readonly pools.
stress_test: Foreign/equalbits/mixed/reordered/stale/forged refs; different authority same pointer equality.
falsification_probe: A JSON label can register a real Source/code permit or fake event passes membership.

assumption: Finite helper physical behavior matches current independent Core contract, not universal C++ language laws.
basis: Core Raw/values/memory/ranges plus verified Machine comparison.
stress_test: Poison/inrange priority, undef/freeze, masks/ranges/empty/top/partial, type/owner refusal.
falsification_probe: Native perbit and Core span/state outputs or actual traps differ.

assumption: Original actually issued address roots remain retained.
basis: Witness keeps actual source/registry/Machine/foreign-owner tuples alive.
falsification_probe: Permit issued from labels/bits, or source-root cleanup claimed without actual holder protocol.

assumption: Original canonical B and finite attempt bound cannot be rebound through normal API.
basis: Readonly original bindings/registries and prepaid scans.
dependent_result: Bounded guards/capture and exact same resource errors.
stress_test: Public/private normal assignment, overcap, zero/exact/one-less, actual growth+resource.
falsification_probe: Ordinary setter resets original budget/attempts/native path or guard reads above snapshot+1. Excludes hostile reflection/private-table/code mutation.

assumption: Physical memory model uses one process memory context and grants no permissions.
basis: Core sequential Memory oracle, model functional images; actual Core writes separate.
falsification_probe: Model JSON or cross-session image grants actual Core access. No cross-process DataPtr/atomic/volatile/device/parallel proof.
